gates: The source ELF, stdin and expected stdout manifest is hashed and confirmed by its independent owner before deployment.
All three repeated diagnostic predictions for all cases must be frozen and confirmed by the modeling owner before deploying or contacting the service. No curve fitting with these measurements.

historical_model.source: test-only transferred weights from the earlier historical diagnostic

full_runs.order: Sort case IDs and rotate left by 0, 1, then 2 per round. Within every case run native before, ordinary three-counter live v8, native after.

boundaries.N: exact median of six full native run CPU ns
boundaries.P: median of three frozen full-run research-model predictions in ns, when per-row predictions are stored as integral ns
boundaries.round: nearest whole positive millisecond after multiplication, ties rounded upward, minimum 1 ms
boundaries.schedule: In sorted case order, process the two N bounds first and then the two P bounds; low then high. For each distinct (case,limit), collect 3 independent native statuses. Collect one real ordinary historical-v8 status for any N bound. Reuse results for shared rounded limits, retaining each label. No retries on valid discordant results.
boundaries.candidate_prediction: TLE if frozen P > limit_ms * 1000000, Accepted otherwise. All individual native responses including mixtures retained. New model is scored offline only.

validation: Require request/expected-stdout digests at both gates and prior to submission; same v8 installation/policy/source with raw CPU+wall > nominal. Retain ns timings, source, status, work counters and observed termination; check every complete high-cap run matched stdout. Report all spreads rather than silently discarding unstable sets. Verify per-request HTTP placement and clean up revision/service/registry package.
